## blowhorn report

Generate a consolidated report summary from the exports already sitting in the repository-root data/analytics/ directory. Reads local files only - run `blowhorn analytics` first if you want fresh numbers.

```text
blowhorn report [OPTIONS]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--no-open` | boolean | `false` | Write data/analytics/analytics_report.html without opening a browser |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` | Emit machine-readable JSON output |
| `--platform` | string |  | Platform scope. `blowhorn report` is not platform-specific, so the only accepted value is `all` (the default) |
| `--pace` | string |  | Accepted by `blowhorn report` because `--pace` is a global flag, but this command does no paced work -- it sleeps between nothing -- so the value changes nothing about how it runs and appears only in the Pace column of the -v summary. Resolved as CLI flag, then `BLOWHORN_PACE`, then defaults.pace in .blowhorn.yaml (normal when none is set); an unrecognized value is rejected before anything runs |

Also takes the [shared flags](/docs/reference/cli/shared-flags/): `--config`, `--log-dir`, `--profile`, `--exclude`, `--headless`, `--chrome-launch`, `--headed`, `--dry-run`, `--verbose`.

Examples:

```bash
blowhorn report --dry-run
blowhorn report
blowhorn report --no-open --json
blowhorn analytics --profile lee && blowhorn report -v
```

Output: json with `--json`, text otherwise.
